name: ModelVariant72_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant72_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a ribbon trails behind the slot's parts, one row recorded a frame and shaded from the start to the end colour; two fans of triangles open and fade in front of the slot, a sprite plays eight frames of the texture, and, when the command asks for them, 48 sparks fly out. During the lead time the entry only records the parts' positions); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-89/219 images build the same source unchanged, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
